items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: All the ones I remember was Steve Lewis and Jonathan Sears.

ctx.x: Oh, he wasn't playing then. Who? Steve. Did he play that or? Yeah he played that.

Oh I see him. Did he have a band? Yeah. That's where we left off. Yeah, I think that's where we left off. Who was in the band besides Steve? All the ones I remember was Steve Lewis and Jonathan Sears. We left Piron's band, the peak pen, that's the only one I remember.
